title: Jungle Green Letters
hook: Different bodies move through green differently.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: colorful 3D jungle storybook, rich greens with flower accents, friendly creatures, clean toy-like silhouettes

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child tracing honest movement paths while still noticing stationary plants, nests and trunks
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: reset the motion vocabulary without asking children to imitate dangerous wildlife
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written motion-specific lines; stationary targets anchor the choreography and dangerous animals stay observation-only
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: motion cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe abstract or object-specific gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. soft marimba droplets and hand-percussion answers, never masking words
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: soft marimba droplets and hand-percussion answers, never masking words
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Use movement as the organizing language: every living target has its own honest motion—climb, cling, glide, slither, step, swing, flutter—while plants and nests become anchors that motion passes around.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child watches motion paths across the jungle; verbs carry the rhyme and line rhythm more than object definitions do.
semanticArc: climbing and swinging widen the paths
light wing motions close the sequence
forbiddenGenericLanguage: plants and creatures look and see
